title: Sable and the Confession
author: Ines Ishikawa
blurb: Dominic Montrose, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
